units.source_text: 某个早上，朝霞即将散去，像往常一样他跟着父亲去百木杭散步。

en.t: One morning, just as the dawn glow was about to fade, he went for a walk to Hyakumokugui with his father, as usual.

units.source_text: 百木杭是大川岸边钓鱼人最多的地方。

en.t: Hyakumokugui was the place on the bank of the Okawa where fishermen gathered in the greatest numbers.

units.source_text: 但是，那天早上，抬眼望去，却看不见一个钓鱼人。

en.t: But that morning, when he looked up and around, not a single fisherman was in sight.

units.source_text: 宽阔的河岸上，只能看见石垣之间的船虫缓慢蠕动。

en.t: On the broad riverbank, all he could see were sea slaters slowly crawling between the stone walls.

units.source_text: 为什么今天早上没人钓鱼呢，他正想问父亲。

en.t: He was just about to ask his father why no one was fishing that morning.

units.source_text: 但是，他还没来得及开口，忽然就知道答案了。

en.t: But before he could open his mouth, he suddenly knew the answer.

units.source_text: 在朝霞照耀下的摇晃的水波里，有一具秃头尸体漂浮在杂乱的木桩之间，

en.t: In the wavering water lit by the morning glow, a bald-headed corpse was floating among the disorderly wooden stakes,

units.source_text: 木桩周围积满了散发臭味的水草和垃圾。

en.t: and around the stakes, foul-smelling water plants and rubbish had piled up thickly.

units.source_text: ——那天早上百木杭的这一幕，至今仍记忆犹新。

en.t: That scene at Hyakumokugui on that morning remains vivid in his memory even now.

units.source_text: 三十年前的本所，在多愁善感的信辅记忆里，留下了很多值得回忆的风景画。

en.t: The Honjo of thirty years earlier had left many memorable landscapes in the sentimental Shinsuke's mind.

units.source_text: 但是，那天早上的百木杭——那张风景画，却成为本所的街町在信辅心中投下的心理阴影的全部！

en.t: But Hyakumokugui on that morning, that one landscape, became the whole of the psychological shadow that the streets of Honjo cast over Shinsuke's heart.
